question: Identify the author of the book 'The English Teacher'
solution:
The correct answer is __**RK Narayan**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **R. K. Narayan:**

 
 
• His full name was **Rasipuram Krishnaswamy Iyer Narayanaswamy.**
 
• R K Narayan's books: Raj - Swami and Friends (1935), The Bachelor of Arts (1937), **The English Teacher (1945),**__ The Painter of Signs (1976), A Tiger for Malgudi (1983), and Talkative Man (1987).
 
• He was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1960 for his novel** 'Guide'.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Salman Rushdie -**

 
 
• He is a famous **British Indian novelist and essayist.**
 
• His** famous novel is Midnight's Children** (1981), for which he received the Booker Prize in 1981.
 
 
 
• **Khushwant Singh -**
 
 
• He was a **famous journalist, writer, novelist, and historian **of India.
 
• His major novels are famous - **'Delhi', 'Train to Pakistan', 'The Company of Woman'.**
 
 
 
• **Vikram Seth -**
 
 
• He is a famous **novelist and poet **of Indian literature.
 
• He is best known for his** four major novels -**
 
• **The Golden Gate **(1986),** A Suitable Boy** (1993), Sanet, An Equal Music (1999).
